title: Publish reproducible reports and append experimental lab notes
description:
## Scope

Provide offline report commands, figures, text-free result bundles and artifact checksums, an experiment inventory, and an article with hypothesis, investigation, results, and limitations. Append dated lab notes instead of rewriting the historical Few-Shot-Jev experiment as product documentation; link evidence to Decision-Flywheel feature issues.

## Definition of done

A clean offline replay reproduces published aggregates; all claimed effects link to plans and result artifacts; a study may be published once completed without waiting for the entire model matrix.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-5ac13e11-6bd8-5787-8136-8f936b5930f8`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.
